    • Class com.andreibel.message.DTO.SchedulesReportResponse

      class SchedulesReportResponse extends Object implements Serializable

      • Serialized Fields

        • closingTime
          LocalTime closingTime
          Restaurant closing time. x Default: 23:00 (can be configured)
        • customerArriveDeparture
          Map<LocalDate,Map<LocalTime,Integer>> customerArriveDeparture
          Customer arrival times grouped by date and time. Map<LocalDate, Map<LocalTime, Integer>> Example: 2025-12-20 -> { 14:30 -> 2 customers arrived at 14:30, 14:45 -> 3 customers arrived at 14:45, 15:00 -> 1 customer arrived at 15:00 }
        • customerDelay
          Map<LocalDate,Integer> customerDelay
          Total delay minutes by date. Time from physical arrival to being seated at restaurant. Calculation: orderArriveDateTime - waitingArriveDateTime (in minutes) Example: 2025-12-20 -> 45 total delay minutes (Customer 1 waited 15 min, Customer 2 waited 30 min)
        • customerLate
          Map<LocalDate,Integer> customerLate
          Count of late customers by date. Customers who arrived after their reservation time. Calculation: If waitingArriveDateTime > orderDateTime Example: 2025-12-20 -> 2 customers were late
        • interval
          Integer interval
          Time slot interval for scheduling (in minutes). Default: 30 minutes Used for creating time-slot based reports and analyzing peak hours.
        • openingTime
          LocalTime openingTime
          Restaurant opening time. Default: 11:00 (can be configured)
